answers.reason: The senate deals with central university strategy, whereas the representative was elected by the students of one faculty and only sits in one body.
Budget allocation is a central administrative matter outside the representative's single place of participation.
Selecting professors is separate from the general student teaching and study matters that the student representative handles.
Every member participates in only one body, and the study commission or faculty council cannot both be attended, making the study-specific body more fitting for a student representative.
As the elected voice for faculty students, the representative's single place of participation is the body that deals with degree programmes and teaching.
The examination board handles individual student cases and appeals rather than general student representation, and members only sit in one body.
Internal research funding does not concern student representation, and members do not sit in bodies for other kinds of questions.
Every member participates in only one place, which for the elected faculty representative is a permanent representative body rather than a narrow working group.
Equipment procurement is separate from student representation, and members only take part in one body.
Because every member takes part in only one place where their matters are decided, the elected representative sits in the formal study body rather than an event planning round.
